exposure: Type of HIV acquisition (perinatally acquired vs. behaviorally acquired HIV)
antiretroviral therapy initiation in 1st trimester of pregnancy
cohort: The cohort consisted of pregnant youth with perinatally acquired HIV infection compared to pregnant youth with behaviorally acquired HIV infection.
finding: The study found that pregnancies in perinatally HIV-infected youth were as safe as in behaviorally HIV-infected youth, with observed differences in premature delivery and mother-to-child transmission likely related to treatment and prolonged care.
